11700.commentary: (ANa) ādheyyamukho'ti pāḷiyā pana ṭhapitamukho'ti attho. magge khaṭa-āvāṭo viya āgat'āgataṃ udakaṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā saddahanavasena sampaṭicchituṃ ṭhapitamukho'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ādheyyamukho hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo parassa vaṇṇe vā avaṇṇe vā bhāsiyamāne taṃ khippaññ'eva adhimuccitā hoti.

11701.commentary: (VINa) ānan'ti assāso, no passāso. apānan'ti passāso, no assāso.

examples.text: yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pi, ānāpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti.
ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ānāpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.

11702.commentary: (SNa) ānako'ti evaṃladdhanāmo mudiṅgo. himavante kira mahākuḷīradaho ahosi.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dasārahānaṃ ānako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi. tassa dasārahā ānake ghaṭite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu.

11703.grammar: nt, abstr, from na anaṇa, neg
11703.meaning1: freedom from debt; being debt-free; being out of debt

examples.text: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.

na > an > ān + iṇa + *ya + ka
ānaṇya + ka

examples.text: pattakammaṃ ānaṇyako, sabrahmanirayā rūpena pañcamaṃ, sarāga-ahirājā devadatto, padhānaṃ adhammikena cā'ti.
etaṃ kho paramaṃ ñāṇaṃ, etaṃ sukham'anuttaraṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, etaṃ ānaṇyamuttaman'ti.

na > an > ān + anta + ra + *ika
anantara + *ika
11709.commentary: (DNa) ānantariko cetosamādhī'ti aññattha magg'ānantaraṃ phalaṃ ānantariko cetosamādhi nāma. idha pana vipassan'ānantaro maggo vipassanāya vā anantarattā attano vā anantaraṃ phaladāyakattā ānantariko cetosamādhī'ti adhippeto

examples.text: yaṃ buddhaseṭṭho parivaṇṇayī suciṃ, samādhim'ānantarikañ'ñam'āhu, samādhinā tena samo na vijjati, idam'pi dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

11713.construction:
na > an > ān + anta + ra + *iya
anantara + *iya

examples.text: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā dandh'ābhiññā.

11715.meaning1: seeing the absence of action with immediate results

11716.meaning1: similar to an action which produces immediate results

examples.text: manussaarahantam'eva māretvā ānantariyaṃ phusati, na yakkhabhūtaṃ. kammaṃ pana bhāriyaṃ, ānantariyasadisam'eva.
ko nu hāso kim'ānando, niccaṃ pajjalite sati, andhakārena onaddhā, padīpaṃ na gavesatha.
tatra ce, bhikkhave, pare tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti, tatra, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa na hoti ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso uppilāvitattaṃ.

11718.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; attendant of the Buddha; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in great learning; foremost monk in excellent recollection; foremost monk in retention; foremost monk in total recall; foremost monk in assistance
11718.commentary: (AN 1.219) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahussutānaṃ… satimantānaṃ… gatimantānaṃ… dhitimantānaṃ… upaṭṭhākānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando
11718.notes: Theragāthā verses 1017-1053 (TH17.3, TH260) are attributed to him.

examples.text: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?
evañ'ca vadehi, sādhu kira, bhante, ayyo ānando yena bhikkhun'upassayo yena sā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti.

11719.meaning1: name of four privately awakened Buddhas
11719.commentary: (MNa) ānando nando upanando dvādasā'ti cattāro ānandā, cattāro nandā cattāro upanandā'ti evaṃ dvādasa.

examples.text: durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.
ramaṇīyā, ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ satt'ambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ ānandacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
vande te pitaraṃ bhadde, timbaruṃ sūriyavacchase, yena jātā'si kalyāṇī, ānandajananī mama.

11724.meaning1: full of joy; extremely happy; ebullient; (comm) (or) achieved success
11724.commentary: (SNPa) ānandajāte'ti samiddhijāte vuddhippatte… atha vā ānandajāte'ti pamudite. (SNPa) ānandajāto'ti savanamatten'eva uppannāya pītiyā pītijāto.

examples.text: ānandajāte tidasagaṇe patīte, sakkañ'ca indaṃ sucivasane ca deve, dussaṃ gahetvā atiriva thomayante, asito isi addasa divāvihāre.

11726.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; Ānanda the elder; attendant of the Buddha; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in great learning; foremost monk in excellent recollection; foremost monk in retention; foremost monk in total recall; foremost monk in assistance
11726.meaning2: name of an arahant monk; Ānanda the elder

examples.text: ānandatthero pana bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto sāvatthiṃ gantvā rājagahaṃ gantu'kāmo yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi. ānandattherena gatagataṭṭhāne mahāparidevo ahosi, bhante ānanda, kuhiṃ satthāraṃ ṭhapetvā āgato'sī'ti.
bhagavā taṃ oloketvā sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi. ānandatthero ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyā'ti pucchi.

11733.meaning1: delightful in nature; happy by nature; naturally joyful

examples.text: ānando nāma, mahārājā'ti. ānando vata, bho, ānandarūpo vata, bho! heturūpaṃ, bhante, āyasmā ānando āha, saheturūpaṃ, bhante, āyasmā ānando āha.

11747.meaning1: happiness and joy; delight and mental pleasure

examples.text: kassa kho nām'etaṃ, bhante, evaṃ bhavissati, piyajātikā soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā piyappabhavikā'ti? piyajātikā hi kho, bhante, ānandasomanassā piyappabhavikā'ti.
mamaṃ vā, bhikkhave, pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra ce tumhe assatha ānandino sumanā uppilāvitā tumhaṃ yev'assa tena antarāyo.
cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahanti tena, nihīyati vaṇṇabalaṃ matī ca, ānandino tassa disā bhavanti, hit'esino n'āssa sukhī bhavanti.

11752.meaning2: intentness of mind on one's breathing in and out

11759.meaning1: meditation on the in and out breath

examples.text: bodhisatto ito c'ito ca olokento kañci adisvā vegena uṭṭhāya pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ān'āpāne pariggahetvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ nibbattesi.
anupāda-sodhana-porisadhammo, sevitabba-bahudhātu-vibhatti, buddhassa kittināma-cattārīsena, ānāpāno kāyagato upapatti.

11761.meaning1: section on in and out breathing

examples.text: ān'āpānapabbaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

11763.meaningLit: discourse on breathing in and out

11764.meaning1: mindfulness while breathing in and out; mindfulness during inhalation and exhalation
11764.commentary: (ANa) ān'āpāne ārabbha uppannā sati ān'āpānassati, assāsa-passāsa-nimitt'ārammaṇāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
11764.notes: ten peceptions 1. aniccasaññā, 2. anattasaññā, 3. asubhasaññā, 4. ādīnavasaññā, 5. pahānasaññā, 6. virāgasaññā, 7. nirodhasaññā, 8. sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, 9. sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, 10. ānāpānassati.

examples.text: yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pi, ān'āpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti.
disvāna āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, ān'āpānassatiṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. ān'āpānassati, rāhula, bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā'ti.

11765.meaning1: devoted to the development of mindfulness while breathing in and out; engaged in the cultivation of mindfulness during inhalation and exhalation

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ān'āpānassati-bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti. ān'āpānassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā.

11766.meaning1: stability of mind from mindfulness while breathing in and out; stillness of mind from being aware during inhalation and exhalation
11766.commentary: (SNa) ān'āpānassatisamādhī'ti ān'āpānapariggāhikāya satiyā saddhiṃ sampayutto samādhi, ān'āpānassatiyaṃ vā samādhi, ān'āpānassatisamādhi.

examples.text: ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.

11767.meaning1: development of meditative composure based on mindfulness while breathing in and out (for someone)

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? n'āhaṃ, ānanda, muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ān'āpānassatisamādhibhāvanaṃ vadāmi.

11768.meaning1: together with mindfulness while breathing in and out; accompanied by mindfulness during inhalation and exhalation

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… ān'āpānassatisahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassati evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā'ti.

11769.meaningLit: discourse on in and out breathing

11770.meaning2: Chapter 7 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
11770.meaningLit: section on breathing in and out

11772.meaning2: causes to be brought; has fetched

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.
pakappitā saṅkhatā yassa dhammā, purakkhatā santi avīvadātā, yadattani passati ānisaṃsaṃ, taṃ nissito kuppapaṭicca santiṃ.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.

11775.meaning1: for the benefit; for the advantage; for the good (of)

examples.text: passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā, pāmojjaṃ pīt'atthaṃ pīt'ānisaṃsaṃ, avippaṭisāro pāmojj'attho pāmojj'ānisaṃso, kusalāni sīlāni avippaṭisār'atthāni avippaṭisār'ānisaṃsāni

11776.meaning1: for the benefit; for the advantage; for the good (of)

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, so brāhmaṇo tassā māṇavikāya sāratto paṭibaddhacitto āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpakaṃ kiṇitvā ānetvā taṃ māṇavikaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ te, bhoti, āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpako kiṇitvā ānīto, yo te kumārakassa kīḷāpanako bhavissatī'ti.

11784.meaning1: (of a woman) is brought home; is brought into the house as a wife

examples.text: te mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āhaṃsu, saṃvijjanti kho, bho, imesu sattasu rajjesu pahūtā itthiyo, tato bhoto yāvatikāhi attho, tāvatikā ānīyatan'ti.
yam'pi so pāṇo galappaveṭhakena ānīyamāno dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, iminā dutiyena ṭhānena bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavati.

11787.commentary: (ANa) anutappā hotī'ti anutāpakarā hoti. tattha cakkavattirañño kālakiriyā ekacakkavāḷe devamanussānaṃ anutāpakarā hoti. buddhānaṃ kālakiriyā dasasahassa-cakkavāḷesu devamanussānaṃ anutāpakarā hoti. tena vuttaṃ, bahuno janassa anutappā hotī'ti.

examples.text: ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, kālakiriyā bahuno janassa ānutappā hoti.

11788.meaning1: ultimate end; unsurpassable limit; highest thing

examples.text: etadānuttariyaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇānaṃ yadidaṃ tattha tattha yathābhūtañāṇaṃ. etasmā c'āhaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇā aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā n'atthī'ti vadāmi

ānupubbikathaṃ kathessāmī'ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.

11795.meaning1: talk that develops progressively; graduated instruction; systematic talk
11795.commentary: (ANa) dān'ānantaraṃ sīlaṃ, sīl'ānantaraṃ saggan'ti evaṃ desan'ānupubbiṃ kathaṃ vā, yaṃ yaṃ suttapadaṃ vā gāthāpadaṃ vā nikkhittaṃ hoti, tassa tassa anurūpakathaṃ kathessāmī'ti cittaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā upālissa gahapatissa ānupubbīkathaṃ kathesi, seyyath'idaṃ, dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.

11796.commentary: (DNa) mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo'ti ijjhanassa mahantatāya mah'iddhiko, anubhavitabbassa mahantatāya mah'ānubhāvo.

examples.text: aham'pi kho evaṃ, brahme, jānāmi, sace pathaviṃ ajjhosissāmi, opasāyiko te bhavissāmivatthusāyiko, yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo. api ca te ahaṃ, brahme, gatiñ'ca pajānāmi, jutiñ'ca pajānāmi, evaṃ mah'iddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mah'ānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā'ti.
rājā kira pasenadi kosalo ekasmiṃ chaṇadivase alaṅ'katapaṭiyattaṃ sabbasetaṃ ekaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ nāma hatthiṃ abhiruyha mahantena rāj'ānubhāvena nagaraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karoti
datvā ca bhutvā ca yath'ānubhāvaṃ, anindito saggam'upeti ṭhānan'ti.
so gantvā taṃ bhattaṃ pañcahi paccekabuddhasatehi saddhiṃ saṃvibhaji. taṃ tass'ānubhāvena sabbesam'pi pahoti. te olokentā'y'eva aṭṭhaṃsu.
atha kho cittassa gahapatino etadahosi, yo kho imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako bhikkhu tass'āyaṃ evarūpo iddhi-ānubhāvo'ti.

11799.commentary: (DNt) tasmiṃ tasmiṃ kicce anuyanti anuvattantī'ti anuyantā, anuyantā eva ānuyantā yathā anubhāvo eva ānubhāvo'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ, bho'ti kho, brāhmaṇa, rājā mahāvijito purohitassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā ye rañño janapade khattiyā ānuyantā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca, te rājā mahāvijito āmantesi
